title: MCA Launches 'Corporate Mitra' Scheme for MSME Compliance Training
summary: Offers 150 hours SWAYAM Plus online learning + 6 months on-job training for graduates up to 30 years old.

blocks.content: Offers 150 hours SWAYAM Plus online learning + 6 months on-job training for graduates up to 30 years old.

items: Eligibility & Course: Open to graduates up to 30 yrs old; 150 hrs SWAYAM Plus + 6 months on-job training.
Fee & Concession: Fee ₹3,000 + GST (50% concession for women and NE/Himalayan/Island candidates).
Institutional Partners: Rollout via IIT Madras, IIT Pravartak, ICAI, ICSI, and ICoAI.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Union Corporate Affairs Minister: Nirmala Sitharaman.
